event_summary: A brush moves from the right across a transparent sheet, contacts a red spot, and leaves an elongated curved red mark before moving out of view.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a transparent rectangular sheet on a wooden tabletop and a small red spot near the upper middle of the sheet. A brush attached to a holder at the right side moves inward over the sheet, with its orange bristles near the sheet surface. The bristles approach and then contact the red spot. As the brush continues moving, the red spot changes into a longer curved red trace with two close streaks. The brush then continues toward the right edge and leaves the sheet area, while the curved red mark remains visible on the transparent sheet.

reasons: The transparent sheet, red spot, tabletop, brush, and right-side holder are visible before the main contact occurs.
The red spot is already present and separate from the brush at the start.
